title: Kuestion for Android
description: The Rift Works exam app. Students sit the exams their teacher assigned and practise as often as they like; solo users build their own question banks and mock papers; examiners read their cohort's results on the go.

details.label: Works on
details.value: Android 8.0 or newer, phones and tablets

details.label: Permissions
details.value: Internet access, and permission to install its own updates. No camera, location, contacts, files or notifications

details.label: Account needed
details.value: A Rift Works account, or a student login from your school

whats_new.heading: What's new in 2.4.0
items: Topic strengths now shows your results. It was empty in 2.3.0.
Exams open full screen, so nothing else on the device gets in the way.
Pause: in your own (solo) exams you can stop the clock and come back. Pauses are shown on your result and in History.
Check for updates: a new button in the menu. The app also checks by itself every hour instead of once a day.
Results are easier to read: each answer shows what you chose and, where you were wrong, the correct answer in words.
Choosing a question file now lists JSON files only.
Examiners: the cohort list shows each student's sittings and average score.

install.heading: How to install
steps: Tap Download, then open the file when it finishes.
If your phone asks, allow your browser to "install unknown apps". This is asked once.
Tap Install. If you already have Kuestion, this updates it and keeps your data.

verify.heading: Verify your download (optional)
verify.note: The file checksum changes with every release; the signing certificate stays the same.
